artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan: restore the dropped verbatim_goal and surface the swallowed jq error (atomic-batch, red-first), settle class/severity, collapse repeat entries on blocker identity via the open tags seam, then redeploy and run the full gate set.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan must de-duplicate repeated structured-log writes from one call site, prefer writing an explicit identity key into the log schema's open `tags` object (via an existing `--tags-json` pass-through) and matching on that exact field, rather than substring-matching the human-readable narrative field. Two reasons compound: the narrative is often being reformatted by the same change set, and the narrative draws on fields that are present-by-convention rather than schema-enforced, so an agent rewording them between dispatches silently breaks the key. Compute the identity from only the schema-required subfields. This keeps the whole fix inside the calling script's own file scope -- no writer-script or format-document edit -- which matters when a sibling record has claimed those files as its territory.
